claim.value: Separated concentrations of trajectories in milestone position, waiting duration, returns to active work and time to first publication are proposed signals to seek.
claim.scope: Candidate patterns, not reported observations. The mapping does not specify whether separation must be joint across these measures or may occur in individual measures.

provenance.rationale: The span proposes seeking separated trajectory concentrations across the listed dimensions without asserting observed separation or specifying joint separation.

signal_basis.value: Observe onboarding under common conditions, combine milestone events with timed follow-up questions, and record progress–waiting–return transitions. Seek concentrations in the specified trajectory measures while tracking censoring and reporting accounts with no return or incomplete follow-up.
signal_basis.scope: Prospective descriptive observation within the stated follow-up rules.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the observation procedure, proposed signal dimensions, follow-up limits and incomplete-trajectory reporting.
The claim is supported within its descriptive bounds; no unresolved empirical relation is required to license it.

rationale: The operation records the dimensions needed to seek the proposed concentrations. This atomic claim only identifies candidate descriptive signals; it does not infer causes, fixed customer segments or intervention effects. Within those limits, the operation licenses the claim.
uncertainty: Joint versus individual-measure separation is unspecified, as the frozen claim acknowledges. This does not prevent treating either as a candidate pattern to seek.
